links.note: UNLINK. Was 31598 'Another summit inside'. The item asks who wrote 'The Summit Within' (Major H.P.S. Ahluwalia). None of the 18 concepts records the author; 31598 is the essay's inward-summit theme, which is what the lesson is ABOUT, not who wrote it.

UNLINK. Was 31602 'Noun forms in -ance and -ence'. The item is an infinitive drill -- 'You are requested ___ me (help)'. This chapter's only two language concepts are 31602 (-ance/-ence noun forms) and 31603 (italicised phrases and their meanings); neither is the infinitive, so the drill has no correct home.
UNLINK. Was 31602 'Noun forms in -ance and -ence'. Same defect: 'She bade us ___ away (go)' is an infinitive drill, not a noun-suffix exercise.

UNLINK. Was 31600 'Inspiration for life's ordeals'. The item is a tense drill in dialogue form ('I ... many of the countries in Central America'). It is matched to a plot concept only because both mention travel; nothing about the climb is tested.

UNLINK. Was 31599 'A peak nobody else can scale'. The item is a tense drill -- 'She ... to several specialists about her problem'. No connection to the essay at all, and no language concept covers reported/perfect tense here.
